# goslop text fixture — CWE-117 internally generated names + numerics (safe)
lang: python
file: CWE-117-generated-name-safe.py
---
import logging
import time

logger = logging.getLogger("app")


def start_worker(first_name: str, last_name: str) -> None:
    start = time.time()
    thread_name = f"Worker-{first_name}"
    attempt = 0
    attempt += 1
    elapsed = time.time() - start
    logger.info(f"{thread_name} starting for attorney: {first_name} {last_name}")
    logger.info(f"ready after {elapsed:.2f}s ({attempt} attempts)")
